title: Cokernels between constant finite pro-etale module sheaves
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring and X a scheme. For finite Λ-modules M,N and any morphism f:constant(M)→constant(N) on X_proet, cokernel(f) is finite locally constant in the sense of [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. Empty X and zero modules are permitted.

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemmas 5.4.1 and 5.4.3; Stacks Project Tag 09AK

proof.text: The constant etale sheaves of M and N are locally constant and have finite stalks. Full faithfulness of comparison inverse image lifts f to a morphism between those etale sheaves.
Their etale cokernel is finite locally constant by IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.cokernel.

Exact comparison inverse image identifies this cokernel with cokernel(f) and carries its finite constant etale trivializations to pro-etale trivializations, by isFiniteLocallyConstant_comparisonUpperStar_obj.
